items.description: Median tonnage and grade of deposit types, with the log10 spread of each (USGS grade-tonnage models)
items.unit: tonnage Mt; grade unit in the row label; spreads in log10 units
items.note: Read from the bulletin's grade and tonnage figures on 2026-10-14 (models 17, 20c, 36a, 25c, 28a, 31a, 15c, 18d, 18b, 14a, 34a, 39a and 34c, the upwelling type). Each spread is (log10 p10 - log10 p90) / 2.563 from the figure's 90th and 10th percentile arrows. Kuroko zinc (median 2.0% Zn) reaches no 90th percentile, so it has no spread and no row. This replaced an earlier transcription made without the bulletin, which had Fe skarn at 49% Fe, phosphorite at 200 Mt and 24% P2O5, and placer gold at 0.25 g/t.

items.description: Diamond grade of mined kimberlite pipes
items.note: Descriptive model 12 (printed p. 54): mined kimberlites yield 0.1 to 0.6 ppm diamond, which is 0.5 to 3 ct/t at 0.2 g per carat. The bulletin gives no grade-tonnage model for diamond pipes, and most pipes are never mined.

items.description: Tonnage and gold grade of alluvial placer gold deposits (65 deposits, predominantly Quaternary) at the 90th, 50th and 10th percentiles
items.note: Read from the bulletin's figs. 196 and 197 on 2026-10-14. The authors converted volumes to tonnes at 2.0 t/m3 (item placer_gravel_density). Gold grade correlates with tonnage (r = -0.35). The descriptive model sites placers where gradients flatten and river velocities lessen.
